answer: To enter the haven of trusted trade, a new identity must grow a trellis of work provenance: each job links to signed attestations from two unrelated collaborators, forming a branching lattice, not one endorsement chain. At random, the network sends a whisper prompt about one past job — a detail only the real worker could answer within minutes — and hashes the transcript into the trellis. A forger must fabricate a cross-checked history per puppet, and one failed whisper prunes that branch; ten thousand puppets need ten thousand histories, costing more real collaboration than any puppet earns.
